customer: Hello, I'm moving out of California for a new job and am selling my cargo van to Northwind Auto before I go. Could you tell me when it's safe to cancel the insurance on it? I'd like to avoid paying for coverage I no longer need, but I also don't want to cancel too early. Thank you for your help.
agent: Thank you for reaching out, and congratulations on the new job! Per our guide "When to cancel your insurance," please keep your van insured until the sale is complete and the van is in our hands, including on the day of a home pickup, and only cancel your policy or remove the van from it after you sign the paperwork. You can ask your insurer about a refund for the unused part of your premium. Before handing over the van, please also remove any toll tags, garage codes and paired phones.
